name: Suzumoto Mayu
source:
One of Ayumi's former classmates, Mayu now works as a production designer. She is still close to Morishige and likes to help him with his acting career, and is often baffled why he isn't able get more roles.

[From [url=http://corpse-party-fanon.wikia.com/wiki/Mayu_Suzumoto_(CPD2)]Corpse Party Fanon Wiki[/url]]
